blocks.title: Von Neumann organisation
blocks.text: Instructions and data share the same address space and a pathway; access can compete for bandwidth.

blocks.title: Harvard organisation
blocks.text: Instruction and data memories/address spaces are separate, allowing independent access paths.

blocks.title: Recognise contemporary designs
blocks.text: Many processors have aspects of both, such as a unified main memory and separate instruction/data caches (modified Harvard).

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: The instruction fetch and data read may both need the same memory transfer pathway.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain and check
blocks.text: The requests may have to be scheduled rather than served simultaneously; this is related to the Von Neumann bottleneck.
